$comment: The shared interface of the three deq CLIs (Node, Python, Rust; PRD 8.9, ADR 0011). packages/cli/scripts/generate.ts turns it into help texts and shell completions for every port. Flag types: bool, string, number, int, choice, list (comma separated; with choices, each item at most once), intlist, pair (name=value, repeatable).
name: deq
summary: Draw Deq shapes, traditional Kurdish tattoo motifs, as SVG, PDF and images.

exitCodes.meaning: a shape, option or spec file is invalid
a file could not be read or written (or exists without --force)
the format is only available in the Node CLI

render.name: color
render.help: Stroke and dot colour (any CSS colour). Default currentColor.

render.name: stroke-width
render.help: Stroke width in grid units, 0.05 to 12. Default 2.

render.name: absolute-stroke-width
render.help: Keep the stroke the same width in px at any size.

render.name: fill
render.help: Fill for closed outlines, or none. Default none.

render.name: fill-opacity
render.help: Opacity of the fill. Default 1.

render.name: stroke-opacity
render.help: Opacity of strokes and dots. Default 1.

render.name: linecap
render.help: Line ends. Default round.

render.name: linejoin
render.help: Line corners. Default round.

render.name: dot-scale
render.help: Multiply every dot radius, 0.1 to 4. Default 1.

render.name: rotation
render.help: Rotate clockwise about the centre. Default 0.

render.name: flip-x
render.help: Mirror left to right.

render.name: flip-y
render.help: Mirror top to bottom.

render.name: padding
render.help: Space around the 24 x 24 canvas in grid units, 0 to 24. Default 0.

render.name: background
render.help: Background colour, or none. Default none.

render.name: layer-color
render.help: Colour of one layer, for example sun=#FEBD11 (repeatable).

render.name: title
render.help: Accessible title. Default the English name; "" marks the image decorative.

render.name: param
render.help: Shape parameter, for example rays=9 (repeatable; see deq info).

render.name: current-color
render.help: What currentColor means in PDF and image formats. Default black.

render.name: matte
render.help: JPG background behind transparent pixels. Default white.

render.name: quality
render.help: JPG and WebP quality. Default 90.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List the shapes in the catalog.

flags.name: category
flags.help: Only shapes in this category.

flags.name: json
flags.help: Print JSON.

commands.name: info
commands.summary: Show a shape's names, layers and parameters.

flags.name: json
flags.help: Print JSON.

flags.name: format
flags.help: Output format. Default svg.

flags.name: size
flags.help: Width and height in px, 1 to 8192. Default 24.

flags.name: layered
flags.help: SVG with one Inkscape layer per shape layer (same as --format svg-layered).

flags.name: out
flags.help: Output file, or a directory for several files; - writes one file to stdout. Default: the current directory.

commands.name: export
commands.summary: Export shapes in several formats and sizes.

flags.name: all
flags.help: Export every shape in the catalog.

flags.name: format
flags.help: Comma-separated formats. Default svg.

flags.name: sizes
flags.help: Comma-separated sizes in px. Default 24.

flags.name: out
flags.help: Output directory; files go to <dir>/<format>/<size>/. Default the current directory.

flags.name: variant
flags.help: Flag variant. Default full-color.

flags.name: width
flags.help: Width in px, 1 to 8192; the height follows. Default 900.

flags.name: format
flags.help: Output format. Default svg.

flags.name: title
flags.help: Accessible title. Default "Flag of Kurdistan".

flags.name: current-color
flags.help: What currentColor means in image formats. Default black.

flags.name: matte
flags.help: JPG background behind transparent pixels. Default white.

flags.name: quality
flags.help: JPG and WebP quality. Default 90.

flags.name: out
flags.help: Output file or directory; - writes to stdout. Default: the current directory.

commands.name: leet
commands.summary: Write text with Deq glyphs (Deq Leet), or read it back with --decode.

args.name: text
args.help: Latin, Kurmanji or Sorani text, at most 1024 characters.

flags.name: decode
flags.help: Print the text of a Deq Leet SVG written at the basic level; pass the render flags used to write it.

flags.name: level
flags.help: basic is readable and decodable, advanced mixes in seeded alternatives, full uses motifs. Default basic.

flags.name: script
flags.help: Glyph table. Default sorani for Arabic-script text, else latin.

flags.name: seed
flags.help: Seed for the advanced level, 0 to 4294967295. Default 1.

flags.name: letter-spacing
flags.help: Space between glyphs in grid units, 0 to 24. Default 2.

flags.name: line-spacing
flags.help: Space between lines in grid units, 0 to 48. Default 6.

flags.name: align
flags.help: Line alignment; start is the right edge for Sorani. Default start.

flags.name: format
flags.help: Output format. Default svg.

flags.name: size
flags.help: Size in px of one 24 x 24 cell, 1 to 8192. Default 24.

flags.name: colors
flags.help: Comma-separated colours given to the glyphs in turn (1 to 16).

flags.name: title
flags.help: Accessible title. Default the normalised text; "" marks the image decorative.

flags.name: out
flags.help: Output file or directory; - writes to stdout. Default: the current directory.

commands.name: generate
commands.summary: Generate a seeded pattern of Deq motifs.

flags.name: kind
flags.help: Pattern kind. Default band.

flags.name: seed
flags.help: Seed, 0 to 4294967295; the same seed gives the same pattern. Default 1.

flags.name: motifs
flags.help: Comma-separated shape ids to choose from (1 to 64). Default every shape.

flags.name: count
flags.help: Band length, odd, 3 to 63. Default 9.

flags.name: cols
flags.help: Grid or border columns, 1 to 32 (border at least 3). Default 5 (grid), 7 (border).

flags.name: rows
flags.help: Grid or border rows, 1 to 32 (border at least 3). Default 5 (grid), 3 (border).

flags.name: petals
flags.help: Rosette petals, 3 to 24. Default 8.

flags.name: spacing
flags.help: Space between cells in grid units, 0 to 24. Default 2.

flags.name: format
flags.help: Output format. Default svg.

flags.name: size
flags.help: Size in px of one 24 x 24 cell, 1 to 8192. Default 24.

flags.name: colors
flags.help: Comma-separated colours given to the glyphs in turn (1 to 16).

flags.name: title
flags.help: Accessible title. Default "Deq <kind> pattern"; "" marks the image decorative.

flags.name: out
flags.help: Output file or directory; - writes to stdout. Default: the current directory.

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: Check a shape spec file and render every parameter variant.
